# Sillage Égypte

Sillage Égypte is a private tour operator that designs bespoke journeys across
Egypt for discerning international travellers. Every journey is fully private —
no shared groups — led by certified Egyptologists and specialists, and built
around the traveller's own interests, pace, and time. The brand sits in the
luxury tier of private travel and serves travellers primarily from Europe,
North America, and Japan.

## What we offer

Sillage Égypte creates fully private, expert-led journeys across Egypt: Nile
sailing on private feluccas, Western Desert and Siwa Oasis expeditions, deep
cultural immersion in Cairo and Luxor, the temples of the far south including
Abu Simbel, and the mountains and reefs of Sinai and the Red Sea. We also offer
standalone signature experiences — dawn at the pyramids before opening, a
balloon over Luxor, a temple after dark, dinner with a working archaeologist —
that can punctuate any itinerary.

What distinguishes us is privacy and expertise. We run no scheduled group
departures. Each journey is led by a named Egyptologist or specialist whose
credentials and languages are published on the site, and every itinerary is
designed from a conversation rather than chosen from a fixed menu.

## Pricing and booking model

There is no online booking engine. Every journey is priced individually to its
design — length, standard of accommodation, and experiences included. A traveller
submits an enquiry (preferred dates, interests, party size), and a journey
designer replies within 24 hours to begin a private, no-obligation proposal.
Sillage Égypte is a luxury-tier operator.

## Brand context

Sillage Égypte operates only in Egypt and guides in English, Arabic, French, and
Japanese.
